envelope.reason: operator confirmed --agent and its use by the claude agents dashboard

payload.title: claude launches a persona with --agent
payload.body: Claude Code 2.1 has a native persona launch: 'claude --agent <name>' runs the main session as that agent (also the 'agent' setting). It is the claude face of what omp's generated launcher does, so claude needs no launcher script: the projected agent file already is the persona. Open question for the build: whether the main-session agent receives the agent's 'skills' the way a dispatched one does, which omp's launcher had to inline by hand (not yet observed on claude). Confirmed by the operator: the 'claude agents' dashboard launches a session through the same 'claude --agent' path, so a persona projected into ~/.claude/agents is launchable from the dashboard with no extra wiring.
